About this study +

Two independent springs deform one continuous image. Each side affects only its own region. Shared deformation and spring linking are disabled. Motion tapers to zero at the center crease to keep the opposite side still.

This is a conservative 2D study. The outer silhouette stays anchored to protect the background; it cannot reveal detail hidden in the photograph. The supplied portrait file is unchanged.

The right response follows the latest color guide: strongest in the red inner/lower area, less through yellow, and least in green, with smooth transitions. Other boundaries were traced from the portrait. Physical iPhone validation of this revision is still pending.
